invariant: one component ID has exactly one color; same visible shape has one ID/color; old IDs and colors preserved
algorithm: greedy farthest-point in OKLab from sRGB-gamut-validated L/C/h grid; anchors from v0.1 preserved; see docs/complete-component-palette.md

data_provenance.caution: Third-party transcription contains explicitly noted OCR errors in example data (not redistributed here), duplicate visible forms, 30 non-Unicode brace-delimited descriptions and rare characters. unsupported_form_policy: Descriptive forms receive distinct IDs/colors, but cannot be correctly colored in text without verified outline/stroke geometry. Plain text retains original glyph.
